description: Na₄Mg(CoO₃)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.64 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.66 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.89 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.85 Å. Mg is bonded to five O atoms to form MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four CoO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one CoO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.27 Å. There are two inequivalent Co sites. In the first Co site, Co is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted CoO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MgO₅ trigonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one CoO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one MgO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.79-2.01 Å. In the second Co site, Co is bonded to four O atoms to form CoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids and  an edgeedge with one CoO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.81-2.05 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and two Co atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Co atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one Co atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Co atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one Co atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two Co atoms.
